reviews.text:
Aqua Bright has been servicing our pool for three years now (each photo is a different year). We tried two other companies prior, but they were inconsistent with service and slow to respond to requests or corrections. AB has not only been extremely consistent, but also reliable and flexible.

Anytime we reach out with a problem or request, Emily responds within minutes and is professional and cordial, swiftly handling anything we throw at her.

They have helped us with a couple maintenance issues at a great price and with fast service. They also gave us a recommendation for some new pool coping which turned out perfect and way cheaper than we expected.

A+++ all around!
reviews.author: Chris Lankford

reviews.text: I decided to try Aqua Bright Pool Service; their tech came over to inspect the pool and generate a quote. I highlighted a couple of items for which I wanted to be more pleased with the service delivered by the prior company.  I also asked him to provide me with a quote and suggest if I should patch or replaster the pool.  After about a month of email exchanges asking me to tell them what type of plaster I had on my pool, I never got the quote and stopped asking for it, as I was not trusting the so-called "Pool Experts" anymore. The monthly cost of cleaning the service was better than my former service, and I decided to move forward with them.  They started "cleaning" the pool, and a week or two later, I started seeing green mold.  I reached out to them, and a "specialist" suggested that it was caused by the fact that we were using the same swimming clothing in the lake and bringing it to the house.  I indicated it was not the case because we had not been on a lake for over a year, and it all started when they took over the cleaning service contract.  She said she would let the cleaning tech know and address it while saying I had to purchase an additional service to address the Green Mold issue; this went on for a couple of more weeks when I noticed there was no improvement in the Green Mold situation, I decided to terminate the service shortly after I saw an invoice for the cost of an entire month of cleaning services when I had terminated the service a week into the actual month. I ignored it and did not intend to pay that invoice, as I had spent significant money on chemicals to remediate the mess they left behind.  Today, I received a letter threatening me with placing a lien on my house if I didn't pay the bill.  I decided to pay the bill and added a note that I was not going quiet and would post this review.  While I do not favor trashing anyone, sharing my story with others was necessary for anyone considering doing business with a company such as Aqua-Bright. I would recommend they do their homework and not walk in blindly.
reviews.author: Carlos G Gonzalez

reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of getting my pool re-plastered and new tiles with Steve. I have nothing but great things to say. Pool looks fantastic! Initially, we picked out different colored tiles but Steve helped us pick a better option for our pool specifically. Steve provided guidance on how to maintain my new plaster and periodically checked in on me after the work was completed. If anyone needs work on their pool, Steve is the man! Communication and service was excellent!
reviews.author: Frank Choi

reviews.text:
On 06/30/24 contacted Aqua Bright in Frisco, TX about a quote to address issue with cloudy green algae in our 10,000 gal in-ground pool.

The person I was speaking with on the phone requested that I send pictures of the pool in order to provide me a quote to remove or treat the green algae and restore ideal ABC levels. When I received a call back I was told it would be a little over $700-800 to remove the algae, restore the pool balance levels and return to check to see if what was done took care of the problem.

I thus contacted another Pool maintenance & service company & they wanted to drain our pool (even though we explained we’ve had it drained a year and a half ago) and add certain chemicals which included a follow up visit to ensure everything was working to clear up pool. Their price was over $1000

I visited a Pinch-A-Penny Pool, Patio & Spa supply store in my area and provided them with a water sample from pool. To my surprise I was given a print out of products to purchase that we could use to address the issues of green algae and correct the pool levels. The purchased total was about $200. We Followed the instructions and the problem was resolved within 1 week.

The lesson always check out several company’s and options before taking the word of one or two so-called professionals. Sometimes it pays to do your research then DIY.
reviews.author: Barb C

reviews.text: Worst experience ever with any pool service. I had a pool that haven’t been used in one year, they came and gave me a quote of almost $1,000. Even though it was too expensive and there were cheaper options I decided to move forward because they claimed to have pool experts or what not. Less than two weeks later the whole pool turned green. I asked for their help again and they gave me a quote of almost $700. Very disrespectful through email as well. At the end of the day it turned out that the small businesses are much much more convenient and cheaper. One of the worst experiences as a customer in my life…
reviews.author: Ali Gharib

reviews.text: I started using Aqua Bright for weekly service after they did my remodel which I’m extremely pleased with. They have been very professional to work with.

reviews.text: Thanks for getting my pool turned around so quickly last month. Other companies were either too expensive or said they would give me an estimate and then never showed up. Im enjoying the weekly service as well, it's nice to not have to do it myself.

reviews.text:
We asked for a weekly maintenance quote, some one from this company showed up, and stated that he will give us a quote as soon as possible like the following day.  He never did, we were calling his office but they never answer us. What Informal and dishonest way to handle business.
It only take some one to say,  sorry we can't handle your business bc we don't have  the capacity and knowledge to handle your commercial pool.
reviews.author: Cesar Guevara

reviews.text: We used them for 2 years. In the last 8 months we have experienced so many issues with the quality of the service to our pool that we decided to go with another company. The new company came today which our day that Aqua Bright would come out. Come to find out the tech that has been servicing our pool had messed with the setting to our pool and it was not running properly. They claim to have researched my account to investigate what happened with my pool, well if you have any questions please email me and I will gladly show you how well they treat their customers. I have been in and out of the hospital for the last year and a half due to illness. The condition that my pool was in during their service only added more undo stress and frustration. I feel like I was more than patient and my husband will also confirm the poor customer service received with this company. We took photos and sent them to an email on their site only to get a response stating that they need to get it together, that email is not longer linked to them and they were sick and tired of get Aqua Brifht’s customer complaints. That added with the fact our pool look the same way it looked did when the tech arrived as it did when left pretty much made our decision to leave and go with another company. High price for low quality work!!! Beware
reviews.author: Amy Henry

reviews.text:
This is my first negative review of a company and it gives me no pleasure to do so. I was a ten year customer of Aqua Bright and they have some excellent employees. Their pool equipment repairman James is the best and their office manager Laurie, has always been a pleasure to work with. If asked a year ago, I would have given Aqua Bright 5 stars. Unfortunately, the past few months, the unreliability of the pool technician has soured me. The pool technician has another job as a fireman in a neighboring city. When his work schedule changes, he changes the day he cleans my pool. Because of security concerns, I only unlock my gate on the day he is supposed to come. Before this technician, the service was reliable and the pool technicians kept a consistent schedule. However, over the past several months, this technician would either not show up on the scheduled day or cancel. It became problematic despite my understanding that emergencies come up. Earlier this month I emailed Emily in the front office asking for another technician, Dominic, (very reliable) but was told he was in another service area and only filled in as needed when my technician was gone. Thus, I had to stay with my current technician.
I was going out of town this Wednesday and saw where my technician was scheduled for Tuesday. Excellent, I thought, as I wanted my pool serviced before I left. I confirmed with the technician the prior week and he said he would be there Tuesday and also confirmed with Laurie. But Tuesday came and at 5:00 I text Laurie wondering if the technician was coming. I was then told his vacuum was broken and wouldn’t be out. I would have understood if he had contacted me earlier or had let Laurie know. I found it to be very unprofessional to be stood up (again) after stressing the importance of having my pool service before going out of town. I am a patient man, but do not like having to track down my pool technician or have to guess when he is going to come (if at all).
It’s a shame really, as there are good professional people working at Aqua Bright, but could no longer put up with the unreliability of this employee and the company that makes excuses for him and didn’t make customer satisfaction a priority.
reviews.author: GaryC Plano

reviews.text: I have a had a great experience with Aqua Bright. I appreciate the work!

reviews.text:
We have been so pleased with our pool
Service with Aqua Bright  Josh is awesome. He is always willing to answer our questions that we have. We had another service that stopped servicing pools and they sent another place to service us. We were not happy with them at all. No service notes and such and very rude. We had Aqua Bright come out and our cya was very high so they at first were not going to be able to service us. We explained the pool was being drained for a remodel. They came out and started once we explained our situation. Our pool is clear and we even upgraded our service to include more. Everyone at the office is so polite and friendly.  We are very happy and would recommend them to anyone who wants service that is great!

reviews.text: Fantastic pool cleaning and I love that they are open 7 days a week.
reviews.author: japp333

reviews.text: Quick response time. They were a pleasure to deal with. Chris came out the next day to give me an estimate to clean my pool, filter, and salt generator. They are very fair priced and had someone come out the very next morning to clean everything. I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Corey Kaplan

reviews.text: Aqua Bright Pool services has been one of the best companies I have worked with. The customer service here, especially Chris, are amazing at answering questions and doing immediate house calls - they even teach pool school. They really go out of there way to make sure you are completely satisfied with their service and are always there to help in any way that they can. I would recommend this company to anyone.
reviews.author: Diane Wang

reviews.text: We've used Aqua Bright for our weekly pool service for over 2 years and couldn't be happier with the service. Chris and his team are always on hand of answer (sometimes random!) questions and for repairs. They also walk you through everything so you understand what could otherwise be very complicated and are very responsive. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Emily Harding

reviews.text: Chris and his team are phenomenal!  I'm a first time pool owner, and they have been so patient answering all my questions.  They have done a beautiful job caring for my pool and addressed any problem we've encountered with very cost effective solutions.  I can't recommend them enough!
reviews.author: Jessica Hopkins

reviews.text:
Terrible customer service.  There was no communication between the person servicing your pool and the homeowner.  Our pool equipment lost power and they failed to tell us for 1 1/2 weeks (during winter).   They do not recommend any services or practices to help keep your pool clean.  They hate dogs so if you have any dogs in the yard be careful.  We figure our service person must have done something to our dogs because they wouldn't even go near him.  If you are trusting someone to come into your property near your pets you want to be able to trust them and this was not the case for us.  When you try to talk with someone if you have an issue it is very difficult to get someone to call you back.  Laurie in the office was wonderful but you cannot say the same for other manager or the service people.

There are too many pool companies out there for this kind of customer service (or lack of) and expect your company to be recommended.  This is not a 'service' company that I would recommend.
reviews.author: jtigedf unkk

reviews.text: I've used several other companies over the years and have been with Aqua Bright for the last 2 years. They have been the best company I've found and I enjoy working with them.

reviews.text: Best pool company I've used in 25 years of pool ownership. Not only are they good at cleaning and maintaining but are also always available even during the summer months.
reviews.author: John Bentke

reviews.text:
Bad experience, didn’t realize how bad until I quit using them and hired someone else to clean my pool !!!
Beware, if you do not know much about caring for your pool this company will take advantage of your lack of knowledge!  If you do not have cameras around your pool be aware that they are probably doing nothing and charging you!
reviews.author: Katy Benson

reviews.text: I signed up for bi-weekly pool service which is what made sense for my budget as a single mom. At the point of sign up, there was no indication that the bi-weekly service was to ever change or end as well as they advertised it. My bill drastically changed (which they require auto debit) and they said that starting at this time of year they no longer offer bi-weekly services. I was in shock because it was never discussed when I signed up for the service...instead they said well we put a small note on the invoice that it was going to be changed and believe that is appropriate notification which it is not appropriate notification when you have never indicated that you service would change when someone signs up for something, let alone that they auto debt and you see the invoice, but would never see the note unless you downloaded and opened everything. They refused to refund the services and believe that it was ok what they did. It was horrible service which they also charged me because there were issues with my pump because there was debris in it....later I come to find out that there was debris in it because they technician was not emptying the pump basket!

reviews.text: Excellent customer service with competitive pricing!  The technician does a great job cleaning and servicing our pool and I am appreciative for their responsiveness when we have had issues.  It is nice to see a business that has a heavy emphasis on customer service.

reviews.text: This company has my business for life! Laurie is always delivering top notch service. Dominic has my pool looking amazing year round! Couldn’t recommend this business enough.

data.summary: The reviews present a mixed and concerning picture. The positive Google reviews may be inflated or for a different business. The Yelp rating is very low, and the available negative review details specific, credible problems including service failure, billing disputes, and threatening communication. This suggests authentic, significant customer service issues.
fake_signals: Potential review mixing with a different, highly-rated company (Aqua-Bright Irrigation)
Yelp data appears to be promotional snippets, not actual review content for analysis
Lack of detailed negative review text from Google to fully assess patterns
authentic_signals: Specific negative review details (green mold, lien threat, email exchanges)
Varied ratings across platforms suggest organic feedback
Long business history (19 years) implies a real customer base
complaint_patterns: Failure to provide quotes/ghosting after initial contact
Poor service leading to algae/mold problems
Billing disputes and threats of liens
data.discrepancy_explanation: Major discrepancy between Google HQ (4.9/856) and Yelp (2.4/23). The Google HQ rating appears to be for a different 'Aqua-Bright' company (irrigation). The local Google rating (4.3/56) is more relevant but still significantly higher than Yelp.
